what: Reconstruct a Triangular Mesh from a 3D Point Cloud — createMesh
title: Reconstruct a Triangular Mesh from a 3D Point Cloud — createMesh
text: Reconstructs triangular surface 3D point cloud returns mesh3d object. function performs linear binning using npsp::binning(), optionally adds zero-valued border around point cloud X Z directions, removes low-density nodes, truncates high-density nodes extracts isosurface using misc3d::contour3d().

title: Reconstruct a Triangular Mesh from a 3D Point Cloud — createMesh
code: createMesh(   panel,   resol_nbin = c(4, 4, 2),   mesh_cad = NULL,   zero_border = FALSE,   k_factor = NULL,   trunc_factor = 3.5,   level_factor = 0.99,   coverage_tol = 0.99 )

title: Reconstruct a Triangular Mesh from a 3D Point Cloud — createMesh
text: panel numeric matrix data frame three columns containing X, Y Z coordinates point cloud. resol_nbin numeric vector length three defining approximate binning resolution X, Y Z directions. Default c(4, 4, 2). mesh_cad Optional. mesh3d object used reference determining minimum spatial coverage reconstructed surface. NULL, dimensions input point cloud used instead. Default NULL. zero_border Logical. TRUE, one zero-valued layer added lower upper sides X Z directions extracting isosurface. FALSE, external zero-valued layers added. Default FALSE. k_factor Numeric. Factor used compute tolerance removing low-density nodes. NULL, automatically assigned according resol_nbin. Default NULL. trunc_factor Numeric. Factor used truncate high-density node weights. Default 3.5. level_factor Numeric. Factor used define isosurface extraction level truncated weights. Default 0.99. coverage_tol Numeric. Minimum proportion reference bounding box dimensions must covered reconstructed surface. reference taken mesh_cad provided, input point cloud otherwise. Default 0.99.

title: Reconstruct a Triangular Mesh from a 3D Point Cloud — createMesh
text: list containing: mesh: reconstructed surface object class mesh3d. bin: processed binning object. contours: disconnected triangular surfaces returned misc3d::contour3d(), ordered largest smallest. params: list containing parameters used reconstruction process.

title: Reconstruct a Triangular Mesh from a 3D Point Cloud — createMesh
text: Disconnected surface components sorted size progressively merged reconstructed surface reaches specified proportion reference bounding box. mesh_cad provided, CAD model dimensions used reference; otherwise, dimensions input point cloud used. Linear binning computed using npsp::binning(), corresponding grid coordinates obtained npsp::coordvalues(). isosurface extracted using misc3d::contour3d(), implements Marching Cubes algorithm. zero_border = TRUE, one external zero-valued layer added sides X axis sides Z axis. creates transition occupied empty regions can facilitate surface closure isosurface extraction. Low-density nodes removed using tolerance based mean number points per occupied bin. High-density node weights subsequently truncated, Marching Cubes extraction level defined truncated value. several disconnected surfaces generated, ordered largest smallest merged reconstructed surface reaches coverage_tol times dimensions selected reference bounding box.

title: Reconstruct a Triangular Mesh from a 3D Point Cloud — createMesh
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Reconstruct a mesh without adding zero-valued border layers result <- createMesh(   panel = panel,   resol_nbin = c(4, 4, 2),   zero_border = FALSE ) mesh <- result$mesh  # Reconstruct a mesh adding one zero-valued layer on the X and Z borders result <- createMesh(   panel = panel,   resol_nbin = c(4, 4, 2),   zero_border = TRUE ) mesh <- result$mesh  # Use a CAD mesh as reference for the coverage criterion result <- createMesh(   panel = panel,   resol_nbin = c(4, 4, 2),   mesh_cad = mesh_cad,   zero_border = TRUE ) mesh <- result$mesh  rgl::open3d() rgl::shade3d(mesh, col = "lightgray") rgl::decorate3d() } # }

title: Split a Mesh into Connected Triangle Groups — splitTrianglesInd
text: implementation generates three edges every triangle, encodes undirected edge using numeric key identifies shared edges vectorized sorting operation. avoids repeated pairwise intersection calculations improves performance large meshes. algorithm follows steps: Checks mesh contains matrix. Generates three edges every triangle. Represents edge ordered pair vertex indices. Encodes edge using numeric key undirected edge receives value regardless vertex order. Sorts edge keys identify triangles share edge. Builds undirected graph triangles vertices shared edges define graph connections. Identifies connected components using igraph::components().
